Book correction: The answer key prints \int_{0}^{5} f(x)\,dx. That is the result only if the third integral is added, i.e. \ldots + \int_{1}^{5} 5f(x)\,dx \ldots: then E = 5\int_0^1 f + 5\int_1^5 f - 4\int_0^5 f = \int_0^5 f. With the signs as printed the result is \int_{0}^{1} f(x)\,dx - 9\int_{1}^{5} f(x)\,dx (test f = 1: -35, not 5). Either the key or the sign before the third integral is a misprint.
